title: Classified video meeting: smiling official says it may not be from our planet

tellings.quote: I recently spent meeting where was guy by video communication in secret mode, which is a little smiled.

plain: James Valor, of Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call up UFOs, says that in 2025 he was in a classified video meeting, "in secret mode", where an official smiled a little and said what they were discussing may not be from our planet. Valor tells Michels he was in the meeting himself, and he tells it as a sign that some officials privately take the idea seriously.
